speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Double Aortic Arch. The clinical presentation of recurrent stridor and wheezing specifically exacerbated by neck flexion (the "torticollis" sign), combined with feeding difficulties and vomiting in an infant, is highly characteristic of a vascular ring compressing the trachea and esophagus. The normal vital readings rule out acute respiratory failure, confirming the need for definitive structural imaging. REQUEST IMAGES: Barium_Swallow_Study and Cardiac_Angiography.
